chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: How does bundling auto and home save me money?

chunks.text: When you quote and purchase both an auto and home policy together in a single flow, a multi-product discount is automatically applied to both policies, delivering meaningful savings on your total insurance cost.
